extracted.intended_audience: business leaders, corporate decision-makers, investors, risk managers, and subscribers of Dow Jones/WSJ products
extracted.subtask_description: Corporate homepage copy describing Dow Jones products and qualities of its news, data, and analytics offerings aimed at informing business and investment decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trusted news, data, and intelligence
rubrics_metrics.description: Turning news and data into decisions — Dow Jones delivers trusted news, data, and intelligence to help leaders see clearly, act quickly, and move confidently.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positioning claim that the core product must be 'trusted' and useful for decision-making; emphasizes outcomes (see clearly, act quickly, move confidently) rather than specific formats or channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grounded in facts and unwavering editorial standards
rubrics_metrics.description: The world’s source for business news and market insight — Grounded in facts, shaped by experience, and defined by editorial standards that don’t waver.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frames factual accuracy, experienced reporting, and consistent editorial standards as a central quality metric for content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Premium reporting and expert analysis for decisions that matter
rubrics_metrics.description: Premium news for decisions that matter, in business and in life. Get the facts, follow the markets, and see what’s coming with trusted reporting and expert analysis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes that reporting should be actionable, forward-looking, and expert-driven; implies content should support both immediate market following and strategic foresight.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data, analytics, and reporting built for business decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Data, analytics, and reporting built for business decisions — Empowering businesses with premium data, AI-driven analytics, and actionable insights to ensure regulatory compliance, inform strategic decisions, and drive growth in competitive markets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies that data products must be AI-enhanced, actionable, and suitable for regulatory, strategic, and growth use cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure compliance and manage regulatory & reputational risk
rubrics_metrics.description: Risk Management — Ensure compliance and manage regulatory and reputational risk with best-in-class, reliable and actionable data and platforms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positions regulatory compliance and reputational risk mitigation as explicit objectives for the product; 'best-in-class', 'reliable', and 'actionable' are the implied quality standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specialized market coverage (Energy Markets)
rubrics_metrics.description: Energy Markets — Leading news, data, and analysis for energy, chemical, and environmental markets worldwide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the criterion of domain specialization: provide leading, domain-specific news/data/analysis for sector stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corporate research enhanced by generative AI
rubrics_metrics.description: Corporate Research — Power strategic decisions with news, information and business intelligence, enhanced by the power of GenAI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies that corporate-research products should integrate GenAI to enhance intelligence and strategic decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trusted real-time news and investment data
rubrics_metrics.description: Investment Data — Strengthen financial decisions by leveraging trusted real-time news, data and analysis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires timeliness ('real-time') and reliability ('trusted') for information intended to support financial decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Experience, speed, and scale
rubrics_metrics.description: When every move counts, you need experience, speed, and scale you can trust.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frames three operational qualities—expertise (experience), timeliness (speed), and capacity/reach (scale)—as necessary attributes of the service.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scale and coverage metrics as evidence of trust
rubrics_metrics.description: 70M+ Professionals at 16,000 organizations rely on Dow Jones; 2,000+ Experts deliver the reporting and analysis; 700+ AI specialists build models; Millions of signals are monitored daily; 33K+ Global sources feed the most complete view of business and markets; 11,500+ Companies are tracked in real time for actionable corporate events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Uses concrete quantitative metrics (users, experts, AI specialists, signals monitored, sources, companies tracked) as evidence of breadth, depth, and operational capability; implies these are measures by which service credibility and coverage can be judged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusive leadership network and community value
rubrics_metrics.description: The WSJ Leadership Institute is a members-only network of the world’s most influential leaders across industries, sectors, and borders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positions an exclusive, peer-networking membership as a product quality: curated access to influential leaders and conversations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Events designed to move conversations into real-world impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Events — Bringing visionaries together to drive ideas into action. Our global conferences, special interest forums, and exclusive experiences are designed to move conversations forward and turn ideas into real-world impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treats the capacity to convene high-impact events as a criterion for value delivery: programming should be global, idea-driven, and outcome-oriented.
